# Anything-to-Journal

Anything-to-Journal is a folder-first agent skill that turns source material into an editable journal manuscript.

## Documentation

- /docs — Introduction
- /docs/getting-started — Complete first-run workflow
- /docs/folder-contract — Source workspace contract
- /docs/templates — Draft mode and journal-template mode
- /docs/overleaf — Upload the generated ZIP to Overleaf
- /docs/troubleshooting — Compile, citation, figure, and evidence fixes

## Essential workflow

1. Create a new folder dedicated to one manuscript.
2. Put every relevant source in that folder.
3. Open the agent from inside the folder and invoke Anything-to-Journal.
4. Confirm a flexible journal draft or a specific journal template.
5. Review the generated manuscript and generation report.
6. Upload `journal-output/submission/overleaf-upload.zip` with Overleaf: New Project > Upload Project.

The generated ZIP has `main.tex` at its root.
